name: cache-timer
description: A real-time countdown to the prompt cache's expiry above the prompt, green to yellow to red as it runs out.

ttl.title: Cache lifetime
ttl.description: auto follows Claude Code's rules (FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M, CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL, promptCacheTtl, ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H, then 1h on a subscription, 5m otherwise) and corrects itself from request timing; 5m or 1h pins it

yellowAt.title: Yellow at (share left)
yellowAt.description: The timer turns yellow when this share of the cache lifetime is left (0.25 = 15:00 of a 1h cache)

redAt.title: Red at (share left)
redAt.description: The timer turns red, and one toast shows, when this share of the cache lifetime is left (0.1 = 6:00 of a 1h cache)

toast.title: Toast when it turns red
toast.description: One toast per cache entry when the timer turns red
